text:
Alex Chen: AM async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

What I did: quick sync with Kestrel execs, pushed updated pilot SOW, flagged BYOK requirements to legal. Updated CRM notes for Acme Pilot.
Blockers: waiting on KMS keywrap approval (legal + infra); need an on-prem test run for Dedicated pilot — SRE capacity unknown.
Today: follow up with eng-sre for onprem slot, get KMS approval timeline, draft customer-facing email for pilot kickoff.

Maria Gomez: noted — legal said they'll review keywrap text by EOD. I uploaded the KMS policy doc to the deal folder: https://redwood.internal/deals/acme/docs (permissions: sales+security).

Jon Patel: tagging @Ryan O'Neill — can you confirm if we have a spare onprem window next week? we need 4 hrs with ops to validate HSM/KMS integration.

Ryan O'Neill: yep, I can carve out a slot Wed 09:00-13:00 PT. Need a list of exact tests. pinging eng-sre in #eng-sre for ops runbook and to reserve the node.

Luis Herrera: Alex — I drafted the kickoff email. quick copy below, can someone sanity-check tone + compliance line?
> Hi Team, excited to kickoff the Acme Dedicated pilot next week. We'll need onboarding info and a KMS key for BYOK. Please review attached SOW and security addendum.

Maria Gomez: quick sanity check: include this sentence — "Redwood will perform on-prem connectivity tests with Acme during the scheduled window; Acme must confirm network ACLs and firewall rules 48h before the run." saves back-and-forth later.

Jon Patel: +1 on the sentence. Also add a short bullet about SOC2 evidence timeline — customers ask for that.

pipeline-bot: Deal Update: Acme Inc. moved from Negotiation to Pilot (owner: Alex Chen) — expected pilot date: 2026-04-02.

Alex Chen: thanks bot :thumbsup: — Maria, can you attach the legal review PR link when ready? Jon, I'll add the SOC2 bullet. Ryan — I'll DM the exact test matrix in a sec.

Ryan O'Neill: got it. quick checklist for SRE ops run (feel free to copy):
```
- Verify HSM connectivity (key wrap/unwrap)
- Confirm KMS key import and policy enforcement
- Run sample inference job (1k tokens) and verify latency targets
- Validate audit logs shipping to customer SIEM (if enabled)
```

Maria Gomez: legal review started. PR: https://git.redwood/legal/pull/412 — should be done by 18:00 PT. I'll post comments inline.

Luis Herrera: posted the email draft to the drive and added a line about data retention. pls review before I send.

Alex Chen: action items from me: 1) prep test matrix for Ryan (10:30 PT) 2) follow up legal (EOD) 3) finalize kickoff email and send by 16:00 PT.

Jon Patel: I'll update CRM with the pilot window and add reminders for network ACL confirmation (48h).

pipeline-bot: Reminder: Weekly pipeline review in #sales-triage at 15:00 PT.

Alex Chen: ok team — that's it from me. any quick blockers?

Maria Gomez: none from legal side, just waiting for eng signoff on test matrix.

Ryan O'Neill: none, will confirm the Wed window once eng-sre replies.

Luis Herrera: none, will wait for final email copy.

Jon Patel: all good.

Alex Chen: :rocket:
